bioconductor.name: RTNduals
bioconductor.summary: Analysis of co-regulation and inference of 'dual regulons'
bioconductor.description: RTNduals identifies co-regulatory loops between pairs of regulons inferred by the RTN package by evaluating their shared target genes. It infers dual regulons and tests whether regulator pairs exhibit cooperative or competitive influences on common targets.
bioconductor.author: Vinicius S. Chagas, Clarice S. Groeneveld, Gordon Robertson, Kerstin B. Meyer, Mauro A. A. Castro

bioconda.name: bioconductor-rtnduals
bioconda.summary: Analysis of co-regulation and inference of 'dual regulons'
bioconda.description: RTNduals is a tool that searches for possible co-regulatory loops between regulon pairs generated by the RTN package. It compares the shared targets in order to infer 'dual regulons', a new concept that tests whether regulators can co-operate or compete in influencing targets.
